answer_1.quote: We conceptualize document editing as a text generation task by expressing the document as an HTML+CSS rendering ... Document editing is inherently a generative task as it involves the creation of a new edited output from an existing document.

answer_2.quote: Automated Metrics: Apart from the document metrics reported by for command text generation (Exact Match, ROUGE-L, Word Overlap F1, Action and Component Accuracy %) and RoI bounding box prediction (Top-1 accuracy %), we adapt two novel metrics specific to HTML document editing: (1) DOM Tree Edit Distance, (2) CSS IoU.

answer_4.quote: Every edited document HTML is evaluated by three human evaluators on our three proposed metrics: (1) Style Replication, (2) Content Replication, (3) Edit Correctness.
answer_4.guideline: Each metric yields a binary score, which is averaged across evaluators and summed to compute a unified score for each document.
